cancellationPolicies.label: Deposit Only rates
cancellationPolicies.description: This property has a 2 day cancellation policy. Failure to cancel within this time will result in a cancellation charge equal to the first night of your stay, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information).

privates.name: Superior Double Bed Private Ensuite
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription: These modern DOUBLE ROOMS feature 1 queen-size bed, free WiFi and a flat-screen TV and your own private bathroom and air conditioning, fridge, tea & coffee facilities and desk

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only
paymentProcedure.description:
Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.

rateRuleViolationsMessages.description: Requires a minimum of 7 nights stay on your dates

specialEventConditions.title: Important Note!
specialEventConditions.description:
Please be advised that we will not accept arrivals or departures on the following dates this holiday season: 25 December 2025, 31 December 2025, or 1 January 2026. Any bookings made for these dates will be cancelled immediately.

All bookings that fall between December 23rd - January 2nd are non-refundable and full payment will be taken upon reservation

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 29th Dec 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 29th Dec 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
